cues.text: Let's get an overview of your school's fees.
Open Finance, then choose Fee Overview. It shows the status of your fees at a glance.
Choose Monthly or Annual view, then the month and year.
Category-wise Collection shows how much of each fee category has been collected.
Collection Progress shows how much of the total due is paid.
Use Collect Payments to record payments, or Fee Setup to change the fee amounts.
